source.rationale: THE ARM THAT SHIPS, and the M1/M2 unreachability proof. Input is miss-roster-plan's own item (members:false), not an http roster, because get-cs-members-miss is not deployed. Decision fields derived before running: miss_plain_offer TRUE; miss_roster_plan carries the plan identity INCLUDING team ('purchasing') so compile-current-state's frozen phrase names the team HI would assign to; codes/multi_company/companies/members are NOT forwarded (the ccs contract is plan_idx/company_id/company_name/brand_code/team). The expected item is compared by deep-equality, so this fixture also ASSERTS THE ABSENCE of miss_member_offer, miss_member_rows and miss_offer_text — M1 (compile-current-state Case A's last_result_set concatenation) keys on miss_member_offer === true, and M2 (the members arm's 'reply with the company name' close, which the live parser has no company_pick arm for) lives in miss_offer_text. Neither key can be produced on this path.
